verdict.rationale: Helix Cloud documents role-based access control and scoped API keys (read-only, read-write, or operation-restricted) issued as dashboard-managed Bearer tokens. Granular permission scopes such as database.query.read gate operations. However, tenancy isolation is left to row-level handling at the application layer, and no per-collection or per-label permissions are documented. Missing for 10: per-collection/per-resource permission enforcement, evidence of access control in self-hosted/local mode, detailed role definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
